candidates.status: Exact fit and current catalog listing. Manufacturer package is 3.2 x 2.5 x 2.5mm. Samsung's DC-bias data are typical design-reference data, not guaranteed minimum capacitance. For 9V VBUS, qualify effective capacitance from the Samsung DC-bias curve/design simulation against BQ25895 input-capacitance requirement; do not treat 22uF nominal as guaranteed under bias. Typicals are not guaranteed; doubled input capacitance increases stored charge and inrush at a given voltage.

dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C101: Samsung product page specifies 1210 (3225 metric), dimensions and nominal rating. Its DC-bias graph is identified as LCR measurement data and Samsung explicitly labels page data typical for design reference only. A plotted typical value is not a guaranteed minimum.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C102: Samsung maker datasheet confirms 0805 dimensions, rated value and dielectric. Account for typical DC-bias reduction at REGN operating voltage; do not claim guaranteed retention.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C106: Murata maker PDF is saved locally; use Murata's Part Number Search / SimSurfing characteristic data at 4.2V to estimate. Candidate not qualified here to a guaranteed minimum effective capacitance.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C5: The selected 1206 part is a documented Samsung 4.7uF 50V X7R production part. 0805 4.7uF 50V was not selected because LCSC search surfaced the established 1206 option; larger package is an authorized practical change, footprint must be changed if adopted.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C101_numeric: Samsung embedded typical curve at 9.0V is approximately -47.7% capacitance change (52.3% retention; 11.51uF from nominal 22uF). Including the requested illustrative initial tolerance factor 0.90 and temperature factor 0.85 gives ~8.80uF before aging/chart uncertainty, only ~0.60uF / 7.3% above TI BQ25895 suggested 8.2uF for typical 3–5A charging. This margin is narrow and not qualified as guaranteed. Two parts are now fitted in parallel (C101 and C108). Nominal branch total is 44uF; this increases startup charge/inrush in proportion to capacitance at the same voltage.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C102_numeric: Samsung typical curve at 6V gives approximately -60.2% for CL21B106KPQNNNE 10uF/10V, ~3.98uF biased; 0.90*0.85 illustration yields ~3.04uF. Same-value 16V CL21B106KOQNNNE curve is ~4.33uF at6V, yielding ~3.31uF by the same factors. TI identifies 4.7uF nominal ceramic as the REGN pin description recommendation; the nominal value wording does not establish an effective-capacitance limit, so confirm using TI guidance/bench evaluation. Two parts are now fitted in parallel (C102 and C109), 20uF nominal. This increases REGN startup charge/current; nominal 20uF alone does not establish compliance with TI effective-capacitance guidance.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C100: LCSC listing confirms exact Samsung CL21B225KBYNNNE MPN, 0805, 2.2uF, 50V, X7R. A standalone exact MPN manufacturer PDF was not retrievable; the hidden Datasheet field links the exact LCSC part page.
dc_bias_and_package_evidence.C180_at_20V: Samsung exact-family official curve typical at 20V: -30.05% ΔC, ~0.700uF typical; illustrative 0.90 initial-tolerance × 0.85 temperature gives ~0.535uF, above 0.1uF before aging/chart uncertainty. See charger-review/samsung_CL21B105_C28323_curve.json; typical only, no guaranteed minimum.

limitations: LCSC stock/price was not captured for C103 or C106 in this run.

No effective capacitance values are represented as guaranteed. Verify converter capacitor minima from BQ25895 datasheet and qualify with manufacturer's exact-part bias data at the actual DC operating point.
C101/C108 and C102/C109 duplicate branches increase input/REGN charging demand; startup inrush cannot be quantified without the applicable ramp and source impedance.
C100 exact listing verified; a standalone exact MPN PDF could not be obtained in this run, so its symbol Datasheet property points to the exact LCSC listing.
LCSC stock and unit prices for C51205, C309062, C32635 and C2762602 were explicitly captured from their linked product pages on 2026-10-05; they can change before ordering.
For the integrated C5, active schematic value remains 4.7uF X7R 50V and footprint is now 1206; this snapshot reflects the current schematic.

CL21B105KBFNNNE.conclusion: C180 is located after Q2 on the eFuse input rail and can see 5/9V normal operation and 20V fault voltage. Exact Samsung typical curve at 20V gives ~0.70uF typical, ~0.535uF after illustrative tolerance and temperature factors, above the 0.1uF local requirement. This remains typical-only and does not account for aging/chart uncertainty or eFuse fault transient behavior; qualify to the actual fault profile.

CL21B104KBCNNNC.conclusion: suitable 50V part for values displayed with 25V minimum rating; listed LCSC MPN/package match.

charger_sheet_revision.inrush_note: The input capacitor bank and REGN ceramic bank each double nominal capacitance at those nodes; charging energy and peak charge current can increase depending on startup ramp/source impedance. No numeric inrush estimate is claimed without ramp and source impedance.
charger_sheet_revision.C103: Unchanged and left without hidden sourcing metadata.
charger_sheet_revision.design_note: TI BQ25895 §9.2.2.2 describes 8.2uF as suggested for typical 3–5A charging; this is a design recommendation, not a guaranteed/mandatory minimum. REGN 4.7uF is a nominal pin-description recommendation, not a strict biased-capacitance minimum.
